title: Beyond Lognormal Sums: A Four-Moment Probability Framework for Basket and Spread Option Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2608.21498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Basket options are difficult to value under correlated lognormal dynamics because weighted sums and differences of lognormal variables have no tractable distribution. This paper develops a probability-based four-moment framework that separates the exact pricing representation from the distributional approximation. A change of measure first writes a basket price as a linear combination of probabilities. For a standard basket with one positive weight, these probabilities become CDF values of positive correlated lognormal sums. Each sum is approximated by a shifted lognormal variance mixture matched to its first four moments. For an unrestricted mixed-sign basket, a signed shifted lognormal proxy gives an analytical call-price formula. We state admissibility conditions, provide a practical root-selection rule, establish the main strike-based financial properties of the direct proxy, and derive exact pricing-error identities in terms of cumu

translated_title: 超越对数正态和：篮子期权与价差期权定价的四矩概率框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：在相关对数正态动态下，篮子期权难以估值，因为对数正态变量的加权和与差没有易于处理的分布。本文开发了一个基于概率的四矩框架，将精确定价表示与分布近似分离开来。通过测度变换，首先将篮子价格写成概率的线性组合。对于具有一个正权重的标准篮子，这些概率变为正相关对数正态和的累积分布函数值。每个和通过一个移位对数正态方差混合来近似，并匹配其前四阶矩。对于不受限制的混合符号篮子，一个有符号的移位对数正态代理给出了解析看涨期权价格公式。我们陈述了可接受性条件，提供了实用的根选择规则，建立了直接代理的主要基于行权价的金融性质，并基于累积量导出了精确的定价误差恒等式。
tldr: 本文提出一种四矩概率框架，通过分离精确定价与分布近似，利用移位对数正态方差混合匹配前四阶矩，为篮子期权和价差期权提供解析定价方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a four-moment probability framework that separates exact pricing from distributional approximation, using shifted lognormal variance mixtures matched to the first four moments to provide analytical pricing for basket and spread options.
